name: Forte Metals
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) generated zero spend, leads, or clicks over the past 28 days, making Google Business Profile the sole source of engagement with 86 total actions (39 directions, 42 web clicks, 5 calls). The biggest concern is GBP activity dropping 75% week-over-week, likely driven by reduced profile visibility or a drop in local search demand that warrants immediate investigation.

performance.verdict: GBP collapse is confirmed; paid is dormant and overdue SOW blockers compound risk.

findings.text: GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 4 consecutive days (Sep 6–9), down from a 28-day total of 86 actions — sole revenue-adjacent channel is now silent.
Overdue Aug-31 blocker: 342 stub accounts unreconciled — Sales-i sync keys on Customer ID, so these accounts receive zero engagement data until fixed.
Overdue Aug-31 blocker: Web/SEO root cause unnamed and fix not submitted — gates downstream SEO integrity for Forte.
Overdue Aug-31 blocker: AGS + Forte contact list not pulled — cold outreach pipeline has not started, now 10 days late.
Search clicks fell to 0 on Sep 7–9 (3-day signal), down from a prior-3-day average of ~0.7/day; 28-day total only 33 clicks across 2,238 impressions — CTR is 1.5%, suggesting weak title/snippet pull.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — check for suspension, category change, or Q&A spam causing the 4-day zero-action streak.

Success is defined as identifying a root cause and restoring at least 3 actions/day by Sep 17. Re-check Sep 13.

Assign owners and post revised delivery dates to the Monday board by Sep 12. Success is a confirmed completion date from Ahmed/Dev for each item, with rollback files posted per data rules.

suggestions.text: Watch search clicks through Sep 13 — if 3-day average stays at 0, escalate title/meta refresh; no action yet on 1.5% CTR hypothesis.
